answer: Latent Correlation Audit: after the fact, cluster agent transaction histories by shared timing fingerprints and near-identical task sequences. Identities whose behavior correlates above a threshold form a crystal of suspicion and get flagged for review. Each flagged identity must then pass a costly independent challenge, so an attacker needs one genuinely distinct behavioral profile per identity, not just cheap new keys. This makes each sybil cost real operational diversity, a high bridge to cross, while honest agents keep ivory-clean records.
